Welcome To Hickory Sta tion Pizzeria At Hickory Station Pizzeria, we're driven by one simple thing: a genuine love for making pizza. Since 2001, we've been crafting pizzas not just because it's our business, but because it's our passion. There's nothing quite like seeing a customer's face light up after they take that first bite—it's the moment we live for. When someone tastes our pizza, smiles, and shares it with friends and family, that's when we know we've done our job right. For us, great food is about creating memories and bringing people together. Everything we make—from our hand-tossed New York-style pizzas and authentic Detroit pan pies to our signature salads and hearty subs—is prepared with care and the best ingredients we can find. We don't cut corners, because when it comes to taste and quality, details matter. We're proud to serve our community, and we look forward to welcoming you into our family. Stop by soon, take a bite, and let us put a smile on your face. We promise it'll be a memory worth savoring. VIEW OUR MENU Button Button Button Button Real reviews from customers just like you!
